name: bld4_rat_sq_add_sq_eq_mul_sq_trivial
statement: (p n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp3 : p % 4 = 3) (hodd : Odd (padicValNat p n)) (x y z : ℚ) (h : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = (n : ℚ) * z ^ 2) : x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ z = 0
closed: ∀ (p n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp3 : p % 4 = 3) (hodd : Odd (padicValNat p n)) (x y z : ℚ) (h : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = (n : ℚ) * z ^ 2), x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ z = 0
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_rat_sq_add_sq_ne_of_odd_padicValNat: if z ≠ 0 then (x/z)^2 + (y/z)^2 = n, contradicting bld3_rat_sq_add_sq_ne_of_odd_padicValNat; so z = 0, and then x^2 + y^2 = 0 in ℚ forces x = y = 0.
type: ∀ (p n : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p % 4 = 3 → Odd (padicValNat p n) → ∀ (x y z : ℚ), x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = ↑n * z ^ 2 → x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ z = 0
